consequence.statement: Re-executions of istio-iptables skip applying rules when existing rules are compatible, instead of re-applying them.

original.statement: istio-iptables re-executions now skip the apply step when existing iptables rules are compatible.

decision.reason: [ev-b0388a31bd06] says only that istio-iptables can now be re-executed because it skips the apply step when the existing rules are compatible. That is a change in how it runs, and the proposed statement repeats it accurately. The evidence says nothing fails, gets rejected or must be migrated, so no action-eligible kind is justified. A low-severity behavior-change, which only asks for review, fits better than "none" because the runtime behaviour does change.
